svg.title: Deforestation releases 4.1 billion metric tons of CO₂ a year: 10% of global emissions
svg.desc: A calm forest. The trees fall in a rolling wave and a dark cloud of CO₂ billows up from them while a counter reaches 4.1 billion metric tons of CO₂ per year. The camera pulls back: a far larger, paler cloud of all other CO₂ emissions drifts in. The two clouds merge; the dark part is outlined and shown to be 10% of the whole. Source: Climate Council, 2026. Simplified: The explanation is not repeated on an overlay: the last frame already shows all of it (4.1 billion metric tons in 2024, 10% of global CO₂ emissions, the source).

g.text: metric tons of CO₂ per year
